story.title: Flower power
paragraphs_en: Today is Nandana's mom's birthday. Her mom loves flowers. Nandana is thinking deeply about what kind of flowers she can draw on the greeting card.
Do you think she will draw one red hibiscus?
Do you think she will draw the white jasmines?
Do you think she will draw a pink lotus?
She wanted the card to be unique unlike anything else. After a lot of thinking she came up with a brilliant idea.
She created a beautiful and unique greeting card with flowers of different shapes triangles, squares and circles. Do you think her mom will like it? Happy birthday mom, Love Nandana

sentences.text_vi: Hôm nay là sinh nhật mẹ của Nandana.

sentences.text_vi: Bạn nghĩ cô bé sẽ vẽ những bông hoa nhài màu trắng chứ?

sentences.text_vi: Cô bé muốn tấm thiệp thật đặc biệt, không giống bất kỳ tấm thiệp nào khác.

sentences.text_en: After a lot of thinking she came up with a brilliant idea.
